pageCache.text:
Our Vision, Ethos & Values
Built by our community for our community
We want our students to have more than just an education.
We want every student to learn valuable skills and become part of our Bolder vision. We want students to feel happy and safe at Bolder Academy.
We hold and promote three values strongly at Bolder Academy. These values run through everything we do: Be Kind. Be Strong. Be Brave.
We are kind.
We are kind to ourselves and we are kind to others. When we show this encouraging, supportive and respectful attitude we all achieve more.
We are strong.
We are ambitious and determined to fulfil our potential and be as brilliant as we can be. We take care of ourselves, ensuring we are fit and healthy and have a strong belief in what is right and what is not.
We are brave.
We are committed to making the most of all the opportunities put in front of us and we are not afraid to try new things. We go above and beyond what we’re used to in order to create a happy future.
Our wish is that our students leave us as kind, strong and brave young adults who lead Bolder lives, believing that anything is possible.
A Bolder future awaits.

Welcome to Bolder
Creating a Bolder future
I am delighted to welcome you to Bolder Academy, a school where we pride ourselves on nurturing brave, kind, and strong individuals.
We aim to ensure that each student feels like a vital part of our vibrant community. We achieve this by building relationships based on mutual trust and open communication with students & their families. You can be confident that your child will join a supportive community within a nurturing environment, where they feel valued, respected, and encouraged to pursue their aspirations.
We are ambitious for our students and believe that education goes beyond academic excellence. Our outstanding personal development programme is a cornerstone of life at Bolder. We celebrate success at every stage through our rewards system that recognises effort, resilience and achievement, helping students to feel proud of their progress and motivated to keep growing.
In addition, we provide incredible opportunities for students to make real-world connections through partnerships with leading local industries such as Sky. These relationships enrich our curriculum and allow students to experience how their learning connects with the wider world, opening doors to future career paths and aspirations.
Join us at Bolder Academy, and together we’ll begin our journey toward a better, brighter, and bolder future.

Our Vision
A Bolder Sixth Form Braver, stronger, smarter
Our values are to be kind, be strong and be brave. They inform and shape everything we do. They are the Bolder way.
Bolder Sixth Form is about forging your own path for future success and finding your voice. It is about adding to and benefitting from community life.
Working collaboratively with the Sixth Form Student Leadership Team you will develop a strong sense of self-belief becoming braver and bolder than you may first believe.
Academic success requires determination, dedication and self-discipline. Bolder Sixth Form offers you:
All of the above will ensure that you’re confident and strong, well-prepared for an ever-changing world.
Our experienced and passionate teaching staff, coupled with small class sizes and personalised curriculum, will challenge you academically, giving you the means to become even smarter.
We pride ourselves on being a small sixth form. Our family atmosphere allows us to focus on you as an individual giving you personalised attention and support. You will be part of a friendly, kind and happy learning environment. We know you well and we are here with you as you plot your route to university, training or the world of work.
A supportive, supervised, self-study wrap around;

Welcome to Bolder Sixth Form
Welcome
At Bolder Academy we pride ourselves on providing an ambitious, innovative and supportive environment where students achieve academic and sporting excellence.
As a new, small, and family-oriented Sixth Form, we offer a personalised experience where every student is known, valued and supported. We are equipped with state-of-the-art facilities providing you with a modern and innovative learning environment. As a Sixth Former you will have access to newly built science labs, a fitness suite, climbing walls, chromebooks and an opportunity to have a voice in shaping the development of the Sixth Form, playing a leading role in establishing traditions, clubs and enrichment activities that future students will follow.
At Bolder Academy our Sixth Form teaching team is exceptional and experienced. We are able to provide smaller class sizes where students receive individual attention and bespoke support to ensure that no one gets left behind and all students are pushed to excel.

At Bolder Academy, our English curriculum is designed to develop our students into kind, strong, brave young adults where a Bolder future awaits.
The aims of the English Curriculum
Our English curriculum is designed to:
How We Deliver English
At Bolder Academy, we follow the national curriculum and integrate elements of the Ark Mastery Programme at Key Stage 3 to provide a curriculum with both depth and breadth.
Our Approach:
Our curriculum builds on the foundational knowledge from Key Stage 2, progressively guiding students to tackle increasingly sophisticated knowledge, concepts, and skills as they advance.
At Key Stage 4 and 5, we aim to foster an appreciation for our rich and diverse literary heritage, alongside the cultural capital our students deserve. To this end, our selected texts offer students opportunities to explore canonical works, seminal world literature, and impactful non-fiction, nurturing a habit of reading widely and frequently.
Our Intended Impact in English
We will know we have succeeded when our students embody our Academy's three core values both within and beyond the classroom. They will demonstrate:
Kindness: Through clear, confident communication, both written and spoken. Our students will express their ideas and emotions thoughtfully, enriching their cultural, emotional, intellectual, social, and spiritual development.
Strength: By nurturing a genuine love for reading and understanding its essential role in expanding knowledge and building on their learning foundations.
Bravery: By embracing the challenge of studying pivotal works in the English literary canon and articulating their insights with academic confidence and critical thought.
Additionally, we aim to prepare our students effectively for their next academic steps, whether that be GCSE and A-level exams, university studies, or the broader demands of the working world.

Mathematics
At Bolder Academy our Maths curriculum is designed to develop our students into kind, strong, brave young adults where a Bolder future awaits.
The aims of the Maths Curriculum
The aims of the Maths curriculum are to:
Equip students with the necessary numerical skills to become confident, competent users of mathematics be it in their day-to-day lives, further educational or working lives.
Enable students to link simple and complex mathematical concepts together through practice, improved metacognition and independent learning.
Foster and develop a culture and love for mathematics: a desire to try new ideas out, even at the risk of being incorrect but having the courage to try.
How we deliver Maths
Bolder Academy follows the national curriculum and the Mathematic Mastery Programme at Key Stage three to ensure there is both depth and breadth.
Students are taught:
Mathematical fluency – applying mathematical knowledge and skills rapidly and accurately to more complex problems over time.
How to reason mathematically – by following a line of enquiry, developing an argument and justifying conclusions using mathematical language.
How to solve problems – by applying their mathematical knowledge to a variety of routine and non-routine problems.
The design of the curriculum enables students to build upon prior knowledge from KS2 and tackle more complex ideas, concepts and skills.
Throughout KS3 students learn, practice and master key skills whilst continually developing their mathematical knowledge.
Furthermore, students are encouraged throughout their lessons to develop their mathematical language by extending their verbal responses using MAC (Method, Answer, Conclusion).
Wherever possible, students are given the opportunity to use Mathematics to solve problems that they may encounter as adults in the future, such as financial calculations including: budgeting, financial planning, working with interest rates, choosing a mobile network and applying for a mortgage - to name a few.
Our Intended Impact in Maths
We will know if we have been successful when our students live and breathe our three core values within the Academy and beyond. When they demonstrate:
Kindness: By working collaboratively in order to help others understand and enjoy mathematics as well as improving their own understanding through student led learning.
Strength: By understanding the importance of using and applying subject specific knowledge already learnt to a variety of routine and non-routine problems.
Bravery: To view mistakes as a learning opportunity and demonstrate perseverance in seeking solutions.
Equally we want to prepare students effectively for the current and next stage in their learning, whether this be GCSE or A Level examination, University study or the world of work.
